assertions.name: mode_decomposition_reconstructs_exactly
assertions.source: Partial-fraction sectors A (entire) + B (ζ_4 pole pair) + C (u=0 Laurent tower) sum to Δtr_M exactly — the mode-by-mode q-difference solution.

assertions.name: zeta4_residues_are_conjugate_half_i
assertions.source: The ζ_4 = ±i residues are ∓i/2 (|res| = 1/2) — the exact WRT level-4 modular phase, an integer/2 constraint on any candidate f.

assertions.name: zeta4_sector_bar_even_is_exactly_half
assertions.source: The bar-even (charge-conjugation-symmetric) part of the ζ_4 cyclotomic sector is exactly 1/2 — the modular sector's physical content is a pure constant phase.

description: Mode-by-mode solution of the Habiro q-difference structure of Δtr_M via partial-fraction decomposition (the Fourier-mode diagonalisation of the root-of-unity shift σ_q). Δtr_M = P(u)/[4u⁴(u²+1)] (u=q^{1/2}) decomposes into three exact spectral sectors: (A) entire polynomial, (B) the ζ_4=±i cyclotomic pole pair (residues ∓i/2, the WRT level-4 cut), (C) the u=0 Laurent tower (u^{-1},u^{-3},u^{-4}). Records the exact residues / Laurent coefficients and the bar-symmetry (charge-conjugation) sector of each mode. Uses the PR #1622 root-of-unity spectrum as boundary data. Exact symbolic; no fitting; characterization of the q-difference solution, not a bridge to the ladder c_k (still open).

delta_trM.u_convention: u = q^{1/2} (Habiro half-twist; NOT ladder b·ℏ²)

zeta4_modular_data.note: conjugate pair ∓i/2 — WRT level-4 modular phase

bar_symmetry_sectors.interpretation: f must be the bar-even (charge-conjugation-symmetric) part — PR #1602. The ζ_4 modular sector's bar-even content is exactly 1/2.

open_bridge.remaining_step: change of variable u=√q ↦ u_ladder=b·ℏ² to read off the ladder c_k from the now-exact mode decomposition
open_bridge.status: defined computation, not a search (modes known exactly)
